caption: This miso ramen features a rich, golden broth with tender chashu pork, crisp menma, and a naruto fish cake, all topped with shredded daikon and green garnish. Served in a white bowl on a saucer, it gleams under soft lighting against a dark background.

segments_info.text: Dark, smooth, matte surface with subtle reflections and soft shadows around the bowl's base.
Chashu pork slice: light brown, tender-looking, curved, with visible fat marbling and slightly glossy surface.
The miso broth is golden-brown, glossy, and rich, cradling thin noodles and garnishes in a smooth, inviting surface.
Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, tender, and sliced into thin, slightly curved pieces with glossy, translucent surfaces.
White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
Naruto fish cake: round, pale white with pink swirl, smooth surface, slightly textured edges.
